interpretation: Static blocker coverage alone cannot prove the center opening win: a hypothetical local parity swap in column 1 creates a 69-of-69 hitting set.
The column-1 swap is intentionally not claimed to be a jointly realizable response policy. Its purpose is to falsify any argument that equates set coverage with strategic compatibility.
Therefore the center proof must include response-resource, timing, or policy-realizability constraints in addition to WSL upward coverage.
The result is consistent with the response-capacity calculus: a repair can look complete as a set while still being impossible to schedule as one contingent strategy.
anti_leakage: No perfect-play terminal-line subset, solved-state table, or terminal witness classification was used.
